answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-bound identity with random geographic audits. At dawn the network draws a random canyon region and requires proof-of-location plus a locked bond from every agent inside it. Each fake identity needs its own bond, so the attacker's cost rises by a fixed delta per account; a 10,000-identity raid at 400 coins each freezes four million coins, and caught fakes are slashed, wiping out any reward.
